metadata.name: Misleading Heuristic Test Map
metadata.description: Demonstrates the failure mode of Greedy Best-First Search where a locally closer-looking node leads to a severely suboptimal path.

nodes.name: Start Node S (Dispatch)
nodes.description: Starting office point S at origin (0, 0).

nodes.name: Node A (Greedy Trap)
nodes.description: Appears closest to goal with Euclidean distance h=1.0, but connects via an expensive path.

nodes.name: Node B (Optimal Bypass)
nodes.description: Appears further from goal with Euclidean distance h=2.83, but leads to the least-cost path.
